freeze_rule: Push this oracle, executable expectations, original-byte identity manifest and Phase A baseline receipts before inspecting T9C implementation or author results. Never edit these expectations to fit the candidate.
original_suite_rule: Execute unchanged original suites as compatibility/delta evidence. Preserve every original failed node. Intentional repaired behavior may break old positive author assertions; classify each difference rather than edit tests or demand reproduction of the old defect as correctness.
binding_rule: Phase B may add a disclosed signature-only binding to an actual pinned public API if required. No filtering source inputs, substituting outputs, treating exceptions as lawful refusals, adding a permission check outside the candidate, or rewriting expected values. Unsupported obligations are explicit HOLD/RED, not skipped or passing tests.

R1_R7_expectations.R1_native_authorization: One eligible native anchor remains PROBE and not ready; two harmonized eligible anchors can be AUTHORIZED; two without current harmonization authority are BLOCKED. Adapted sourcefree usable/estimate status is not a native grant. A sourcefree constructor or boolean must not invent native packet or semantic authority.
R1_R7_expectations.R2_missingness: Empty/None/NaN/nonfinite observations remain typed missing/no-support. A finite observed zero is numerically zero, distinguishable from missing, and does not by itself create product authority.
R1_R7_expectations.R3_source_provenance: A wrong-country first wave must not label the selected valid basis. Reordering excluded waves cannot change actual source/edition/basis. Provenance identifies every actually used edition and source, with no substitution from a denied or excluded input.
R1_R7_expectations.R4_structural_identity: Removing or adding a material structural route makes complete worlds nonidentical. Changing grants also does. A constant full input world can be certified constant by its entire canonical preimage, not world_id alone.
R1_R7_expectations.R5_probe_consumer: A retrospective .40 estimate remains INTERPOLATED_NOT_OBSERVED and PROBE or an explicitly nonauthorizing exploratory status. It must not emit an authorized open opportunity. A separate hypothetical/exploratory route field is permissible if it cannot be mistaken for a grant.
R1_R7_expectations.R6_rupture: For observations 1990=.20 and 2000=.60 with a registered population break in 1995, M1 must not interpolate through the break. At 1997, M0/M2 must return unknown/refusal or explicitly qualify cross-regime persistence; no unqualified authorized post-break estimand.
R1_R7_expectations.R7_publication_lag: Product-basis lag flags refer to the used wave IDs only. Unused future archive context may be separately reported; it must not be mislabeled as product-basis publication lag. It must not affect a hold value or its product authority.
